mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past month signals an easing monetary policy that reduces discount rates for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative policy support for economic growth.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of months when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.25 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings from lower consumer spending and potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when UNRATE exceeds 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in payroll employment (PAYEMS) and rise in unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals severe labor market contraction, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate deepening recession and corporate profit deterioration.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when PAYEMS declines and UNRATE rises.

mechanism_narrative: During a monetary tightening cycle (FEDFUNDS rising above 4.5% and sustained for 3 months), the S&P 500 typically experiences negative forward returns over the next 20 days as higher discount rates reduce equity valuations and signal reduced economic stimulus.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months during monetary tightening cycles (defined as FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for 3 consecutive months).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) below 110.0 (index 2017=100) signals a contraction in the real economy, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate output and profit margins.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when INDPRO falls below 110.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in housing starts (HOUST) below 1000.0 (thousands of units) signals weak consumer demand for housing, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate reduced consumer spending and economic slowdown.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of months when HOUST falls below 1000.0.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) over the past week signals immediate monetary easing, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants react to the policy shift and reduced short-term borrowing costs.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of weeks when FEDFUNDS declines by at least 0.10 percentage points.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in quarterly real GDP growth (GDPC1) below 0.5% annualized signals a slowing economy, which typically precedes negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as investors anticipate reduced corporate earnings growth and potential recession.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of quarters when GDPC1 growth rate falls below 0.5%.
